text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Happy New Year~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Have you had any osechi yet? I actually 
tried making it from scratch this year~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring some over later if you'd like, 
so please be sure to eat it~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To an extent. But I wanted to fully savor 
the New Year culture to its fullest~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, this is a year of taking on 
challenges. It was also meant to help us 
stay sharp."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since I am to challenge such a great 
predecessor... I wish to do everything 
within my power.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And so~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"New Year's Day is the key to the year's 
plan." Shall we think up our resolutions 
for this year together~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what kind of resolutions are you 
considering?
choice_data_list:
I'll keep passing on my knowledge of 
racing!
I'll help you hone your technique!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Knowledge, is it...? I see~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, once you reach the Classic class, 
you can't win on brute force alone."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please, by all means, hammer all sorts of 
strategies into me~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Would right now today still be all 
right?

Together with an enthusiastic Grass 
Wonder, we spent the New Year picking at 
homemade osechi while diligently studying 
race footage.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
True, we certainly can't have you falling 
ill and missing your race~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course I will be careful as well, 
but... Are you alright yourself, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just because it's New Year's, you haven't 
been staying up too late or overeating, 
have you~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu♪

...We spent New Year's thoroughly 
discussing each other's daily habits.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm, technique, is it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I've been wanting to 
tweak my form a bit to better suit a 
pitch-running style~"

Grass Wonder's powerful pitch-running 
style will surely become a dependable 
weapon if refined.

While her high leg turnover means she 
can't hold her top speed for very long, if 
she can settle the race in that single 
moment, victory will be ours.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Self-control"—I'll prove I can master my 
rushing emotions and gain the ability to 
seize victory♪

And so, along with a fired-up Grass 
Wonder, I held an early 'First Training of 
the Year.'
